description: This file defines the ParserException class for the AWS SDK, specifically within the API parser exception namespace. It extends RuntimeException and implements interfaces for monitoring events and response container handling. The class encapsulates error details such as error code, request ID, and HTTP response, providing accessor methods.

classes.name: ParserException
classes.description: Exception class for AWS API parsing errors, includes monitoring and response data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ParserException with optional message, code, previous exception, and context array containing error details.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the exception, if any.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response object, if any.
